title: Bigelow says aliens are walking among us

tellings.quote: this stuff. And then Bigalow will also in interviews say aliens are walking among us.

plain: Robert Bigelow, a businessman who funds research into UFOs, has said in interviews that aliens are walking among us. Michels brings this up himself in a conversation with the researcher Jeffrey Mishlove, pointing to those interviews without naming any one of them. If Bigelow is right, visitors would not just be passing through the skies but living unseen among people.
